what.action: Three-commit session (two code commits + one close-out flush) shipping Phase 8 Phase E3 cuts 1 and 2 from the open-joining brief under the operator-locked Option 3 hybrid substrate. Cut 1 = the org-side join-policy evaluator + receiveSelfMembership gating. Cut 2 = the open-member roster envelope + pending/accepted buffer.
what.summary: Operator chip-picked Option 3 hybrid at session start (the recommended option per the prior carpenter's letter). Substrate decision locked Phase E3's scope to the acceptor + policy evaluation slice (cut 1) plus the roster publication slice (cut 2). Cut 1 shipped src/features/governance/evaluateJoinPolicy.ts — a pure {policy, selfMembership, holdings} → {accepted, reason} function. Three list-checking kinds (open / allow_list / deny_list) accept or reject purely from the envelope's joiner pubkey with case + whitespace normalization; three proof-requiring kinds (requires_handshake / requires_credential / requires_vouch) reject with a reason naming Phase E4 as the milestone that adds joiner-side proof attachment. receiveSelfMembership in createMembership.ts grew from Phase E2 placeholder (just holdAndAnchor) to a three-gate structural acceptor: envelope shape, org must hold its own self-declaration with a join rule, policy must accept the joiner. HomeScreen.acceptSelfMembership now passes orgDeclaration + holdings through; early-returns with console.warn when the wallet has not declared itself as an org. Cut 1 added 12 tests (188 of 188 total). Cut 2 shipped src/features/connections/openMemberRoster.ts — the open-member roster substrate using the same envelope-shape pattern publishOfficialsRoster uses (credential-kind attestation, subject = org pubkey, credential_type = 'open_member_roster', members leaf = canonical JSON of {member_id, joined_at, self_membership_envelope_id} sorted ascending by joined_at then member_id, issued_at at publish time). Six exports: acceptedSelfMemberships (all self-memberships in holdings addressed to the org, sorted), pendingSelfMemberships (delta minus already-on-latest-roster), buildOpenMemberRosterDraft (pure unsigned builder), publishOpenMemberRoster (full sign + hold + anchor pipeline), findLatestOpenMemberRoster (latest-by-issuedAt selection mirroring findLatestOfficialsRoster), readOpenMemberRoster (shape-tolerant member-list parser). Cut 2 added 14 tests (202 of 202 total). All four gates green throughout. Three manifests updated (governance, connections, transport). No bundle-budget bumps required — openMemberRoster has no production caller yet (Phase E4 wires the publish button + the pending-delta view). Phase E3 substrate is fully landed; Phase E4 (verifier + UI) is the natural next arc.

why.text: Operator opened the session with 'Fire up and continue with a full chunk context session. Any questions for me put in question chips I'll answer for you' — explicit instruction to use AskUserQuestion (PFOR-019 chip-form) for directional questions and to fill the full context window with productive work. Substrate decision was the single most important pending chip per the prior carpenter's letter; surfaced immediately as a four-option chip (Option 1 / Option 2 / Option 3 / Defer). Operator picked Option 3 hybrid as recommended. Phase E3's scope under hybrid splits cleanly into two cuts: the policy gate (cut 1, this session's first commit) and the roster envelope (cut 2, this session's second commit). Both are substrate-only work — no UI yet — so they slot neatly into one full-chunk session and leave Phase E4 (verifier + UI, two-to-three sessions per brief) as the natural next arc. The Phase E2 cut on disk was deliberately written substrate-agnostic per the prior letter, so the Option 3 lock did not invalidate any shipped code; cut 1 simply extended the placeholder receiveSelfMembership behavior into the real acceptor by adding three structural gates around the same holdAndAnchor call. Cut 2 added a new envelope shape parallel to the existing officials-roster pattern, deliberately not extending createMembership.ts further (it sits at 251 lines post-cut-1 and the prior letter named the natural extraction point as a sibling file); the new file is openMemberRoster.ts since the roster is an org-side artifact about members rather than a per-member shape. The hybrid substrate's two verification paths (Option 1 roster walk and Option 2 auth-tree walk) both share the policy evaluator from cut 1 and the roster reader from cut 2; Phase E4's verifier just composes them with the existing findAuthRule + verifyDisclosureProof primitives.

outcome.notes: [P-001] done — evaluateJoinPolicy.ts pure six-kind policy evaluator shipped (86 lines). [P-002] done — receiveSelfMembership grew three structural gates around the same holdAndAnchor call; reject reasons surface through Error.message. [P-003] done — HomeScreen.acceptSelfMembership passes orgDeclaration + holdings; early-returns when wallet has not declared as an org. [P-004] done — openMemberRoster.ts open-member roster substrate with six exports shipped (200 lines). [P-005] done — 9 new evaluateJoinPolicy tests + 3 new receiveSelfMembership tests + 14 new openMemberRoster tests = 26 new tests (202/202 total). [P-006] done — Governance manifest gained the new file in touches + Phase E3 cut 1 paragraph; connections manifest gained the new files in touches + Phase E3 cut 1 + cut 2 paragraphs; transport manifest acceptor-paragraph replaced with cut 1 framing. [P-007] done — All four gates green: typecheck clean, eslint clean, 202/202 tests, build OK with bundle budgets passing. [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: the open-joining brief's Phase E3 description bundles acceptor and roster as 'one to two sessions' — actual experience splits cleanly into two cuts (policy gate vs roster envelope) with almost no shared code other than reading the existing data shapes, so future briefs could specify the cut points explicitly. Also: the Option-3-hybrid lock did not require any rework of the Phase E2 cut on disk because the prior carpenter deliberately wrote it substrate-agnostic — that engineering discipline saved a full session of churn and is worth naming as a pattern in future open-joining-style briefs.

confidence.uncertainty: Storage round-trip through publishOpenMemberRoster's full pipeline is not exercised in tests because anchorQueue.upsert hits IndexedDB which jsdom does not ship. The pure builders + signed wallet.hold are both covered; full publish-pipeline coverage waits for fake-indexeddb or a polyfill if Phase E4 wants storage assertions. Same uncertainty surface as Phase E2 carried forward — the integrity gates and envelope shapes are verified; only the IndexedDB-backed persistence pathway is unexercised.

next: Phase E4 — verifier + UI. verifyOpenJoinedMembership composes findAuthRule (for the auth-tree walk under Option 2) and findLatestOpenMemberRoster + readOpenMemberRoster (for the roster walk under Option 1); under hybrid, accept whichever proof verifies. UI work: org creation form gains a membership-policy picker (open / allow_list / requires_handshake / requires_credential), org-mode Identity tab gains a Members view rendering the chronological roster (founder first by anchor height, joiners after), publish-roster button + pending-delta surface, any-wallet Profile gains a Join-an-org flow (paste / scan org pubkey → see declared join policy → click Join → self-membership signed + shipped over Mycelium). Brief estimates two-to-three sessions. Alternative substantive moves if Phase E4 is too big a swing: Phase D charter-amendment chain (walkCharterChain + findActiveCharter + dissolution endpoint, continues the org-control axis), the three-manifest governance-direction notes sweep (low-energy autonomous polish, fifth session deferred), bundle-budget unnamed-chunk hygiene (11 chunks need named budgets), createOrganization.ts officials-roster extraction (75 lines into a sibling, drops file under soft warn).
